usedFor: Membrain holds sales projects, and Google Docs notes each “New Sales Project Created” through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Sales Project Created” in Membrain, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A new sales project gets written into a doc tab, so the team reads it in one place.

watchOut: “New Sales Project Created” is polling, so the doc updates after a scheduled check.
